shared_elements: standing frontal human figure carved on a vertical stone slab
elaborate headdress occupying the upper portion
circular disc or medallion on the chest/torso
broad belt or waistband across the lower torso
symmetrical low-relief ornament flanking the central axis
pendant / hanging elements from headdress or belt
justification: Both depict a single frontal standing personage carved in low relief filling a tall slab, with a tall elaborate headdress at the top, a prominent circular chest medallion at mid-torso, and a broad banded belt with pendant elements below — a fairly specific vertical hierarchy of ornament repeated in the same order. The chief differences are that A shows a slender full-length figure with clearly rendered legs and feet, arms and dense glyph-like ornament and a profile-headed headdress element, while B is a squat, wide-bodied figure whose lower body is undifferentiated and whose ornament is sparser and more abstract, with no legs or hands legible.
